sources.summary: 25 years of great ideas. Now it's your turn. Registration for the Manufacturing the Future International Design Competition remains open, and there is still time to enter. This edition presents a unique challenge: to design a chair and/or a table that reimagines what furniture can become—sustainable, innovative, and designed for the world we want to build. Your model could be the winner. Register now!
